name: Holiday Recap
description: Catch up after annual leave in one pass — a single prioritised briefing of the mail, meetings, and Teams conversations you missed, with deep links and one-click follow-up actions.
author: Suparna Banerjee
coverImageAlt: Mail, meeting, and conversation signals converge into a calm three-level briefing beside a packed travel case.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org skill gallery cover
Primary request: Create a premium editorial illustration that communicates returning from time away and receiving one calm, prioritized briefing from a backlog of work signals.
Scene/backdrop: A warm paper-toned desk landscape where a small closed travel case and a sunlit horizon sit behind streams of abstract mail cards, meeting tokens, and conversation bubbles converging into an orderly briefing tray.
Subject: A central layered briefing folio with three distinct colored priority markers, linked by elegant paths to abstract envelope forms, calendar tiles without markings, and rounded conversation forms; a single check-shaped paper fold suggests an actionable plan without using a symbol as text.
Style/medium: Premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail, layered cut paper, matte ceramic objects, fine thread-like connectors, restrained and sophisticated rather than playful.
Composition/framing: Exact 16:10 landscape; left-to-right return-and-reconcile story; central briefing folio as the dominant focal point; generous warm negative space; crop-safe focal subject; no essential detail in the outer 8%.
Lighting/mood: Calm, capable, quietly technical; early-morning studio light, gentle shadows, relief and renewed control after absence.
Color palette: Warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027.
Constraints: No text, letters, numbers, logos, trademarks, or watermark; no paw imagery or paw logo; no cats or cat silhouettes; no product UI or Microsoft Fluent branding. Do not show readable calendars, inbox screens, notification badges, tropical clichés, or clutter.
